scope: Desktop Web model configuration center and shared Web/Worker configuration resolution

coverage: legacy import and retained-key retarget protection
whole-snapshot rollback as a new version
independent Worker process reads current version

production.providers: Loopback-only fixtures, no external paid model requests

checks: sidebar navigation warns before losing edits
historical configuration is previewed before restore
restore creates v6 while retaining v4 and v5

limits: Real supplier authentication, quotas, tools, vision and full business tasks await user-provided connections.
Text connection success is distinct from tool, vision or task success.
Machine service settings require restarting Web and Worker; this page does not restart them automatically.
Vector model changes require an index migration/rebuild, which this change does not automate.
Audio model selection remains in the existing implementation; video uses the existing Bailian-compatible chain. Independent CLI settings remain separate.
Phone and native client optimization are outside this delivery.
historicalBaseline: Pre-Pi main branch evidence; current Pi acceptance is model-center-pi-validation.json
